start.filterFormula: OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Global_IMGA_Owner__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Global_Account_Manager__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Global_Account_Director__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Primary_BDE__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Enterprise_ISR__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Tele_CDE__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Information_Governance_Rep__c} ), ISCHANGED({!$Record.DMS_Owner__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.DM_Cloud_Sales_Rep__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Primary_Local_Market_Rep_1__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Library_Services_BDE__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AMD__c}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.RIM_SDE__c}) )
